sun.security.util.math

接口 IntegerFieldModuloP

  • 所有已知实现类:
    IntegerPolynomial, IntegerPolynomial1305, IntegerPolynomial25519, IntegerPolynomial448, IntegerPolynomialP256, IntegerPolynomialP384, IntegerPolynomialP521, P256OrderField, P384OrderField, P521OrderField

    public interface IntegerFieldModuloP
    An interface for the field of integers modulo a prime number. An implementation of this interface can be used to get properties of the field and to produce field elements of type ImmutableIntegerModuloP from other objects and representations of field elements.

    • 方法概要

      限定符和类型 方法和说明

    • 方法详细资料

      • getSize

        BigInteger getSize()
        Get the size of the field as a BigInteger. This size is equal to the prime modulus used to construct the field.
        返回:
        the size of the field.

      • get0

        ImmutableIntegerModuloP get0()
        Get the additive identity element 0
        返回:
        the additive identity element

      • get1

        ImmutableIntegerModuloP get1()
        Get the multiplicative identity element 1
        返回:
        the multiplicative identity element

      • getElement

        ImmutableIntegerModuloP getElement(BigInteger v)
        Get the field element equivalent to the supplied BigInteger value. The supplied value may be negative or larger than the modulus that defines the field.
        参数:
        v - a BigInteger value
        返回:
        the field element corresponding to v

      • getSmallValue

        SmallValue getSmallValue(int v)
        Get a "small" value according to this implementation. This value may be used in optimized forms of some operations to avoid unnecessary calculations. For example, multiplication is much faster when it is known that one of the numbers fits within a single limb. The definition of "small", and the range of accepted values, is implementation-specific.
        参数:
        v - the small integer value
        抛出:
        IllegalArgumentException - when the value is not small

      • getElement

        default ImmutableIntegerModuloP getElement(byte[] v)
        Get a field element from a little-endian unsigned integer stored in an array. The entire array will be used, and the supplied value may be larger than the modulus that defines the field. The array will not be modified.
        参数:
        v - an array containing a little-endian unsigned integer
        返回:
        the field element corresponding to v

      • getElement

        ImmutableIntegerModuloP getElement(byte[] v,
                                   int offset,
                                   int length,
                                   byte highByte)
        Get a field element from a little-endian unsigned integer stored at the specified position in an array. The supplied value may be larger than the modulus that defines the field. This method also takes a byte which is interpreted as an additional high-order byte of the number. The array will not be modified.
        参数:
        v - an array containing a little-endian unsigned integer
        offset - the starting position of the integer
        length - the number of bytes to read
        highByte - the high-order byte of the number
        返回:
        the field element corresponding to the bytes at the specified position
